title: Remind subscribers before they renew
summary: Every morning, text each active subscriber whose plan renews in the next few days, with the date and how to pay.
description: Once a day, reads your active subscribers and texts each one whose renewal date is within the days you choose, with their plan, the date and how to pay. Each subscriber gets one reminder for each renewal date. Keep the 'Renews on' column of your subscribers table up to date (the monthly invoices workflow and the reconnect-on-payment workflow do not change it; set it when you add a subscriber or when they pay). One run covers up to 1,000 subscribers: if you have more, you are told.

params.name: business_name
params.title: Business name
params.description: How your customers know you; it starts every message.

params.name: days_before
params.title: Days before
params.description: How many days before the renewal date the reminder goes out.

params.name: payment_details
params.title: How to pay
params.description: Added to each reminder, for example your account number and bank.

params.name: send_time
params.title: Time
params.description: When the reminders go out, Lagos time.

params.name: subscribers_table
params.title: Subscribers table
params.description: Your subscribers: name, phone, plan, price each month, when it renews and whether they are active. Taskiem makes it for you if it does not exist.

definition.name: Remind subscribers before they renew
definition.description: Texts each active subscriber whose renewal date is close.

steps.name: Use your business name and payment details
Text the subscriber a reminder
steps.when: =has(item.phone) && item.phone != null && string(item.phone) != '' && has(item.renews_on) && item.renews_on != null && timestamp(string(item.renews_on).substring(0, 10) + 'T00:00:00Z') > timestamp(has(trigger.scheduled_time) ? trigger.scheduled_time : run.started_at) && timestamp(string(item.renews_on).substring(0, 10) + 'T00:00:00Z') - timestamp(has(trigger.scheduled_time) ? trigger.scheduled_time : run.started_at) <= duration(string({{days_before}} * 24) + 'h')

input.message: =steps.settings.output.business_name + ': Hello ' + string(item.name) + ', your ' + (has(item.plan) && item.plan != null ? string(item.plan) + ' plan ' : 'plan ') + 'renews on ' + string(item.renews_on).substring(0, 10) + ' (NGN ' + string(item.monthly_naira) + '). ' + steps.settings.output.payment_details

steps.name: Tell you if there are more subscribers than one run covers

input.title: More subscribers than one run covers
input.message: This run covered the first 1,000 subscribers in your table. The rest were left out: the others got no reminder.
